plugins.description: Notes on elements of the iOS Simulator's screen: click an element of your Expo or React Native app, write a note, and send it to your agent as a pill with its testID and a screenshot.
plugins.overview:
Point at the part of your app you mean. Click an element of the iOS
Simulator's screen, write a note, and your agent gets the note with the
element's `testID` and a screenshot.

## Notes on the simulator

Open **Annotate Simulator** in the thread's header menu, or press **⌥⌘A**.
The panel takes a snapshot of the booted simulator and turns on the picker.
Point at an element: a blue box and a label show its type, text, `testID`, and
size. **↑** selects its parent, **↓** goes back. Click the element and write the
note; **Enter** adds it. A numbered pin marks the element, and a pill such as
`1 · Buy Pro` appears in the composer. Press **Annotate** again for the next
note, then send your message. Click a pin to edit or delete its note.

## What your agent sees

Each pill gives the agent your note, the device and app, and the element's
type, label, identifier (the React Native `testID`), value, frame, and
ancestors. It also gets the screenshot with the element outlined and pinned.

Needs a Mac with Xcode's iOS Simulator and
[idb](https://fbidb.io) (`brew install facebook/fb/idb-companion` and
`pipx install fb-idb`). Works with any app on the simulator: Expo Go, an
Expo development build, React Native, or native.
